reviews.author: carol wilkinson
reviews.text: We were on vacation and had an issue with car. The owner of our Airbnb recommended this repair shop. I sent my son in law here to address the issue. It was simply a clamp that needed replacement and cost me very little! Any place, including at home, could have easily taken advantage of this issue, they did not! Thank you so much for being so honest and actually helping someone on vacation. I will never forget this honesty! Thank you so very much!

reviews.author: John F
reviews.text: Brought an older car there (my son’s via my father, and it broke down while he was away) on a recommendation from someone who lives in Avalon. Repair was handled quickly and professionally and the price was very fair for the parts and work they had to do. I’d guess a percentage of people looking at this are away from home and stuck, so the best compliment I can give is that if this garage was where I lived I’d bring all my vehicles here all the time.

reviews.author: Reni Reni
reviews.text: I recently took my vehicle to Dobe’s Auto Repair and had a great experience. The staff was professional, honest, and took the time to explain the repairs needed. The work was completed in a timely manner, and my car has been running well ever since. Pricing was fair, and I appreciated the clear communication throughout the process. I would definitely recommend Dobe’s to anyone looking for reliable automotive service.

reviews.author: Scott Peacock
reviews.text: I own a '25 Jaguar and had a challenging issue that did not warrant a 2 hour drive to the nearest Jaguar dealer north of Philly. Through a reco from Honda I called these guys - they got me in the same day, was waiting for me when I arrived, and had the issue resolved in 5 minutes with friendly service.. in the week before the 4th of July! Thanks guys - one great experience!

reviews.author: William Palladino
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with my experience at this repair shop. I’ve been around vehicles for many years, and I have never been charged $37.18 for a single spark plug. When I questioned the price, I was told it was a “premium “ spark plug and that it was like buying designer clothing. That explanation didn’t make sense to me and did nothing to justify the cost. I understand that quality parts can cost more, but customers deserve clear, honest pricing and a reasonable explanation for why they are paying significantly above what they might expect. I encourage anyone considering this shop to ask for a itemized estimate before approving any repairs and to compare prices if something seems unusually expensive. My experience left me feeling that I overpaid, and because of that, I won’t be returning.Let me be clear.I am pleased with the work done on my vehicle.After calling around to other repair shops,They all charge the same.Another shop was within $100 of what I paid.I am ok with the workmanship of this shop.

reviews.author: Nick Conklin
reviews.text: I was on vacation when the check engine light came on. I had very limited time or options. Dobe's was willing to fit me in even though they were clearly very busy. Service was quick and professional. Price was reasonable.

reviews.author: Cathy Kreyche
reviews.text: I was near Dobe’s when my check engine light went off. Liked what I saw of the reviews and stopped in. Despite being busy, they were friendly and Dobe quickly read the code and diagnosed the problem, a loose oil cap! He noticed an unrelated problem that had been overlooked by a dealer and, after brief conversation, I was impressed and will be bringing my car in later this week.

reviews.author: makenna pelouze
reviews.text: We’ve been going to Dobe’s for years, and we will never go elsewhere! They are incredibly accommodating, timely, kind, and very reasonably priced. It never feels like you are being taken advantage of, everything is fully explained in detail and communication of operations is top tier!! The owner and his wife (at the reception desk :)) are genuine, honest people and their services are very valued by the community!!

reviews.author: George W Barsby III
reviews.text: Dobe's Auto is a class act operation. They were extremely kind, accommodating, professional, and made sure the job was done correctly. We will most certainly be return customers and would highly recommend them to anyone needing auto repair. What a relief it was to move to Cape May with imports and have a reliable shop within 10 minutes of us. Thanks again Dobe's you guys were great!

reviews.author: Danila Bebis
reviews.text: I needed help in fixing my vantage 30yo bmw. Doby was super helpful in letting me know what parts I would need to buy to get my car fixed and setting up the appointment in a short notice. I came in time and got a very high level service at a very affordable cost. Less than a day after I happily drove my perfectly working car home. No headache, no stress, no waste of time. These guys know their business. Thank you! Highly recommend it for your car needs.

reviews.author: Josh Jaindl
reviews.text: Had an oil leak on truck, they took me in without appointment and got me fixed up in 20 minutes. Great people!

reviews.author: Rob Avants
reviews.text: Super accommodating, friendly and reasonably priced!!! We were in town for vacation heading into the Labor Day weekend and experienced an issue with our car. Dobe's was able to fit us in before the weekend despite their full schedule and take care of the problem quickly for us. Thanks to the crew at Dobe's. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Stephanie Avants
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Fast and friendly service, very accommodating, and a reasonable price. We were in town just for the weekend and our car ended up needing emergency service. They fit us in despite a full schedule on a holiday weekend, and we were back on the road in about an hour. Thank you Dobe’s Auto Repair!!

reviews.author: Bruce Angeli
reviews.text: We were on vacation in Stone Harbor. Our car was making a strange sound, but no engine light. The issue was significant in terms of safety. It was quickly diagnosed and repaired. Thanks for a prompt repair experience and for the excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Carol Kandle
reviews.text: Down on vacation & loosing tire pressure. Took car in without an appointment & during the busy lunch hour. A mechanic came out from the garage & immediately checked & plugged my tire. Would highly recommend for prompt, friendly, reasonable service.

reviews.author: Dean Pailas
reviews.text: Dobe runs a top notch auto repair shop, specializing in European cars. It’s rare when you can find a mechanic that you can trust to keep your car running strong. What a great feeling to be able to drop off the car hand them the keys and know that when I come back my car was cared for by a true professional who clearly has a passion for automobiles. They are honest, fair, & extremely knowledgeable. Consummate professionals with a down home touch. I travel 80 miles and pass several dealerships to get to Dobe.

reviews.author: Philip Panzini
reviews.text: “Honest, reliable, and fast. Always takes care of my vehicle like it’s his own. Great service every time, as a landscaper and can't afford any down time on my trucks Dobe gets me in on time fixes what needs to be fixed and never an issue 1000% highly recommend!”

reviews.author: Mike Taylor
reviews.text: I got a flat tire the night before and called Dobes the next day to see if they could fit me in. They said come and they will fit me in but I might need to wait. When I got there they were swamped with work but they still found time to fit me in very quickly for a small $25 tire plug and changing from the spare to the newley plugged tire. It means a lot to me that they took the time to take care of me for such a small amount of money. Highly would recommend and very friendly.

reviews.author: Mark Contreras
reviews.text: We have now used Dobe’s Auto Repair twice and both times, Dobe came through ahead of schedule with great results. The first time was for a transmission-related problem and he called us after he looked at it and gave us an accurate estimate for both cost and time of completion. We were very satisified with that work. Our air conditioning stopped blowing cold air and he offered that we drop the car off and that he’d look at it and recommend what to do. Within less than a 1/2 hour he told us he’d refill the cooling system and that it would last for quite awhile. We picked the car up within the hour for a VERY reasonable cost. It’s clear to us that he runs a very good shop both in the garage and at the front desk. I would highly recommend them for anyone wanting to get quick, high-quality work done on your vehicle. BTW, I am writing this without any encouragement from them.

reviews.author: Alain Charbonneau
reviews.text: Very good service. I had a wheel bearing that needed to be repaired before I could return to Canada with my trailer. The owner took the time to look into my problem and agreed to give me an appointment for first thing on the next morning. The repair was carried out efficiently. Another garage asked me to leave the car for 2-3 days, which I couldn't do. The next day, the parking brake connector came loose. I went back to the garage and they fixed it on the spot making sure it didn't come loose again despite the wear of the connection.

reviews.author: Matt Himebaugh
reviews.text: These guys are the very best. Called the first time about a month ago with a screw in my tire and they looked at it immediately. Pulled it and it was so small and needed no repair so no charge! Still tipped the tech. Already a good sign. Then had an issue of overheating in my work van a few weeks back. Called on a Monday morning and Dobe told me to bring it over and leave it for a few hours. He called back at Noon with a price for coolant flush and radiator replacement and had it all fixed by 4 PM! I barely lost half a days work and Dobe was communicative, friendly and reasonably priced. He doesn’t mess around and is happy to help. He even saw that I needed an oil change and had a grossly expired inspection sticker, all of which he offered to take care at the same time which saved me a ton of time to not have to have rescheduled. I can’t say enough about this shop and they are my new team for auto repair!

reviews.author: Dave Smith
reviews.text: Have been bringing my Mustang here for almost a year now. I’m always taken care of quickly. Never have to wait a long time for an appointment. Dobe and his team have done simple maintenance as well as difficult aftermarket performance upgrades and I am always extremely satisfied with the outcome. His pricing is always fair and they stand behind their work. Very glad to have a local shop I can count on. Would highly recommend to anyone in need of a good mechanic.

reviews.author: Amy Macartney
reviews.text: Dobe’s shop saved me! While down in Wildwood for vacation my air suspension STB. I tried calling every auto shop I could find on Google and none of them would do it until I called Dobe’s! He somehow got the parts and turned it around in ONE DAY!! I didn’t have to worry about finding a room last minute or all the complications and expenses of extending my vacation. Lana was awesome, so nice, updated me quickly throughout the process… I can’t tell you how happy I am, this was a huge stress for me and you guys made everything work out better than I could’ve expected A+++++++ Thank you guys so so so much! I wish I lived closer so I could bring my car here for all services.

reviews.author: Kirby Vargas III
reviews.text: Great shop. Alternator crapped out in middle of night. Towed it here and left keys. They text me early the cost and had it done before long. Great place

reviews.author: Nicholas Phillips
reviews.text: Brought my dads truck there for a radiator issue this morning. They had the issue diagnosed, parts ordered and delivered within 20 minutes and the truck was back on the road within a few hours. Excellent customer service and speedy, quality work. Recommend to anyone needing repairs. Will be back if necesssry!

reviews.author: Judie Boggs
reviews.text: I would give him 10 stars if I could. I was at the beach with my 93 year old mom, when my car started making a very loud noise. Didn’t want to drive 2 hours with her in the car. I called, and they were extremely busy, but fit me in so I could get my mom home safely. Reasonable and very professional. Great job! My car is running perfectly now.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Verzella
reviews.text: My 2009 BMW X5 had a unique problem and I thought I had to start looking for a new car. Dobe took his time and diagnosed the problem and fixed the car right! I was so impressed with his precision and customer service. About 3 weeks later I got a call from Dobe I was thinking it was a wrong number however it was Dobe calling to see how the car was doing and if I had any issues with the car! Impressed! I highly recommend Dobe Auto Repair! Dobe exceeded my expectations and thank him for fixing my car right!

reviews.author: Peggy Poehler
reviews.text: This is my new go to repair shop. Called several shops for an oil change and couldn't get an appointment for over a week. Dobe's was suggested by a co worker and I was able to get an appointment the following day. My car was taken in immediately and my oil change was finished in less than 30 mins. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable. I will definitely be a returning customer!

reviews.author: Shari Nichelle
reviews.text: I was a walk-in and though Mr. Dobe himself was operating the shop as a one-man-band, he got my car in, made the assessment, negotiated over the phone to bring the price down on a necessary part, installed it and even brought me in to explain some things to me. All in the same day. He was pleasant and fair and my car was in great hands. I’ll be back!!!

reviews.author: Lisa Cohen
reviews.text: Every time I have an issue with my car, Dobe’s gets me right in. Latest was a oil pan leak from a Walmart oil change. Fixed my car same day and informed me how to file a claim with Walmart. Reimbursement check in the mail 3 days later. Will never go anywhere else again. Will recommend Dobe’s to everyone! Honest and always helpful. Won’t do work if it’s not needed.

reviews.author: Laurel Kartchner
reviews.text: We were driving mid massive road trip and our car started to overheat. Dobe looked at it, realized it was a minor problem that he didn’t have a part for, and told us how to deal with it ourselves in a way that would let us finish the trip. And, since he said it was a minor thing he didn’t even charge us the diagnostic fee. Couldn’t be happier about the whole experience and the amazing service that salvaged our family vacation!

reviews.author: Mark Ionescu
reviews.text: I came in with a screw in my tire, and the staff was polite and extremely helpful. They removed the screw and confirmed that no repair was needed, at no charge - an excellent experience all around for me. I’ll happily refer people here

reviews.author: Peter H. Wong
reviews.text: These guys are just great! I was visting from out of town and along the way today I had a flat tire. Luck has it that I found this shop nearest me on Google. I pulled in last minute (no call or no appointment), asking if they do tire repairs. As there were several cars in the shop and everyone seemed busy, I was expecting to drop off the car and pick it up later. Then one of the mechanics said to the other, I'll take care of it. And 10 minutes later im out of the shop and ready to roll! Wow! No waiting, no hassle, no bull. Just quick, efficient honest work. Amazing service with most reasonable pricing. Professional and easy going. Will come back again for their service if Im in town and need some help with the car. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. A+++

reviews.author: Carly Crisanti
reviews.text: I got a flat tire and JUUUUST made it to the Dobe’s parking lot around 4:30pm. The man helping me said it would only be 15-20 minutes until he could fix it up. True to his word he was helping me in under half an hour, fixed my flat and even helped adjust something else. Only charged $20! I was so excited I didn’t have to wait hours or until the next day as I usually would have at that time of day.

reviews.author: C. Cooke
reviews.text: A great, honest, and reasonable auto repair shop. There have been others before them in this same location, but I can highly recommend Dobe’s Auto Repair. They are a great team that have always done an excellent job. Very fair and competitive pricing with excellent work.

reviews.author: alexander abolt
reviews.text: First and Foremost the GREATEST AUTO SHOP IN TOWN. They do Great work and are super reliable. Thank you for the great business you provide. Thank you Dobe Auto Repair.

reviews.author: Joe Mollo
reviews.text: Dobe installed a S1025 mail order kit from Livernois motorsports on my 2018 Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk. Couldn't be happier. The Jeep is even more insane with 1000+hp. He had my Jeep back to me in 2 days. He kept me informed the entire time of the progress. He is extremely fair with his prices. Its nice to find an honest and fair mechanic. I definitely recommend taking your vehicle to his shop for any needs. From tires to upgrades.

reviews.author: Nate Bouchard
reviews.text: Dobe's is fantastic. Reasonable pricing, Honest work. Very knowledgeable. Exactly the kind of place you want to take your vehicle.

reviews.author: Stanley Liu
reviews.text: Arrived at Stone Harbor, NJ for a beach week only to find I had driven over a razor blade and had a flat tire. Googled this place, brought it over, and they repaired it in about 10 minutes, charged me $25. Didn't try to sell me an expensive tire or anything else. Amazingly efficient, friendly, and inexpensive. Thanks for saving my vacation!

reviews.author: Doug Standley
reviews.text: My driver’s seat broke on my ‘19 Wrangler and stranded me in NJ (I’m from MA). The local Jeep dealer wouldn’t fit me in so I called up Dobe’s and asked for a miracle. He was able to squeeze me in and get the (very complicated) job done to get me back on the road and home safe. Thank you so much Dobe!! Saved me big.

reviews.author: Linda Williams
reviews.text: The engine in my 2012 Volvo needed replacement and was covered by Car Shield. Dobe was patient and professional while dealing with Car Shield and keeping me informed at every step of the 4 weeks it took them to agree to replace the engine. He installed the engine as soon as it arrived and I can not say enough about his patience and ability. What a pleasure to work with

reviews.author: Makenna Pelouze
reviews.text: Best auto shop ever. I’ve been going here for over 4 years and every time I leave happy. Extremely sweet couple that runs it, very comfortable for a young woman that doesn’t know much about car mechanics. Reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Josh Rich
reviews.text: I Brought my truck to have alignment done instead of just doing alignment and taking my $$$ He showed me the cause of the shake in the front end. I highly recommend this shop for all of your automotive needs. Very professional and honest shop.

reviews.author: Frederick Bianco
reviews.text: Dobe is the consummate professional auto mechanic. In my very first encounter with his shop, he tried to save me some money on a faulty thermostat sensor for my 2015 MINI Cooper Countryman S by using an aftermarket replacement part. When that part unfortunately didn't work as expected, he ordered the OEM as a last resort. When I arrived to pick up my car, he took the time to thoroughly show me exactly what went wrong with my old part and which sensor caused the problem. I was impressed with his demeanor, skill set and integrity. He will definitely be my go-to mechanic in the future!

reviews.author: Michael Castoria
reviews.text: Woke up to find a flat tire. On a Saturday in November there are not a lot of places in the area to get it fixed. I live in Wildwood. After driving around the island and Rio Grande I was getting frustrated. I took a ride thru Court House and found Dobe's open. I went in and asked if they could help me. 10 minutes later my tire was fixed for a very reasonable price. Saved my weekend plans !!! A BIG THANK YOU !!!

reviews.author: MARISA Di PASQUALE
reviews.text: Just Found The Perfect Mechanic. Had my ML350 towed to his shop. Dobe explained the diagnosis then fixed the car without delay, while saving me $$$. He is honest, professional & super nice.

reviews.author: Michael Robertson
reviews.text: My 2007 pickup truck was giving me a low oil pressure warning alarm while pulling a camper down to a nearby campground in cape may court house. Called Friday afternoon and made an appt for service for Saturday morning. Dropped off 9 am back by noon, oil change and replaced oil sending unit. Fair price, could have told me it was something more serious but was honest and ended up being a simple repair. I would def refer other campers to Dobe’s Auto Repair across from McDonalds in cape may court house

reviews.author: Marianne Baker
reviews.text: Went to Dobe's to have a tire repaired. Dobe had the tire off, repaired and replaced in no more than 10 minutes from the time I arrived. The price was reasonable and I will not hesitate to return the next time I have car trouble. Thanks, Dobe!

reviews.author: Jesse Osinski
reviews.text: Dobe's auto repair is the very best mechanic in the Cape May County area. Dobe is honest and his work is perfection! He has recently hired some other junior mechanics who are the cream of the crop in auto repair. If u have an American or foreign car *Dobe's Auto Repair* is the place to go!

reviews.author: Jody
reviews.text: Local. Reasonable. Dependable. Being from out of state, I needed to find a mechanic I can rely on for services to my vehicle whenever I visit the area. I was referred to Dobie’s and am grateful for the recommendation.

reviews.author: Anca Froicu
reviews.text: I have been working with Dobe for several years. He is knowledgeable, honest and professional. If your car needs some work, he is the man! Keep up the good work!

reviews.author: George Brown
reviews.text: Best one in Cape May County! I’ve been using Dobe’s services in many years and would never go to another mechanic in this area. Thanks Dobe!

reviews.author: stag gothic art
reviews.text: I came in with a wheel bearing problem that was extremely bad and making it so that I could not drive my van. The owner fixed the issue on the spot and was extremely nice. I would highly recommend this auto repair shop.

reviews.author: Abby Waldvogel
reviews.text: Fixed our issue in 5 minutes for an extremely fair price. Amazing service, would absolutely recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Daryl Ogden
reviews.text: Super nice owner. Professional. Took me at last minute. Mounted spin balanced and programmed Tire sensor. And put tire back on my truck. Will use again

reviews.author: Joanie Stifanick
reviews.text: Great service very personable I pulled in with a flat tire and they fixed it right away!! They also always fit me right in to do my oil changes A + service

reviews.author: Chris Schwamb
reviews.text: They took care of my dead battery problem very quickly when they were jammed with other jobs. My only question is how a replacement battery for a Subaru Outback costs just under $200 with tax.

reviews.author: Rob Augustinos
reviews.text: I bring my personal and work vehicles to Dobe's. They are attentive, knowledgeable and very trustworthy.

reviews.author: Melissa Flynn
reviews.text: This is a great auto repair shop. They have wonderful turn-around times and are great people to work with.

reviews.author: Dariia Skorodumova
reviews.text: Stopped by for an oil change without an appointment. Guys got it done quick with good customer service. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Michael Miller
reviews.text: Dobe it thee go to guy for auto work in the cape may court house area. Want a turbo kit put on your BMW 750il he get it done. Just need tires he'll get them asap for ya.

reviews.author: John Boucher
reviews.text: I broke down heading to cape may from Philly. My altenator went on me. They got me in immediately and replaced it. Ibwas out within an hour! Great people!

reviews.author: Ben Church
reviews.text: They are the absolute, best, honest, and most reasonable mechanics in the area. I could give them more than five stars, I would!

reviews.author: Daniel Nelson
reviews.text: Dobe's does it right! Great price and quality service! I will continue to take my vehicle here for service and repair!

reviews.author: Summer Light
reviews.text: Great Service Experience! Will be calling them again if I have additional auto problems. Communication was very honest and pricing was very fair.

reviews.author: Steve Vosper
reviews.text: By far, one of the best mechanics I have dealt with. Way to go Dobe!!! He's the only one I know that can do something right to a car!

reviews.author: Mike Nachtigall
reviews.text: Didn't really fix my problem with my truck. So I had to take it to a more experienced mechanic that did fix it

reviews.author: James McElhaney
reviews.text: I've known Dobe for a number of years and since I started driving BMWS I won't take 'em to anyone but him.

reviews.author: Patrick Wyz
reviews.text: Guy fixed a $1200 problem on my white executive s80 volvo for $200 hell yeah I recommend his services!

reviews.author: Jill H
reviews.text: love this place, great work, prices and nice owner! always bring the dog, Bella, a cookie...she's the BEST!

reviews.author: James “dean” dean
reviews.text: Dobe is very customer oriented his prices are very fair .. Go here if you need help with your vehicle!!!!!

reviews.author: Ronald Buck Sr
reviews.text: Take all my vehicles there. Car, Van and Truck. They know what they are doing. Fast in and out service.
